t: Long-life mains powered heat alarm with lithium battery back-up. Features Thermistek technology with a radiant heat dish for a faster response to common kitchen fires. Easy to fit and suitable for use in the kitchen, garage or attic. Can be used with a Specification Smart RF Module to wirelessly interlink multiple alarms to create a network (sold separately).
b: Interlinked via Wireless or when Hardwired (Wireless Module Required)
